definitions.explanation: The act of receiving or welcoming someone.
Going to get someone from a place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧{迎え|むかえ}だった。

examples.english: I was welcomed at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧{迎え|むかえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The president came to greet us in person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{迎え|むかえ}る⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We are preparing to welcome the new employee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}な→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{迎え|むかえ}る⟦ために→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: A large crowd gathered at the airport to welcome the famous singer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{迎え|むかえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'll go pick you up at the airport.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{迎え|むかえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}かなければならない→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I have to go pick up my child from school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{迎え|むかえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}わずに→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦{着|つ}けた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: My friend came to pick me up at the station, so I arrived without getting lost.

notes:
{迎|むか}え is a noun form of the verb {迎|むか}える, meaning greeting, welcome, or pick-up.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {迎|むか}えに{行|い}く: to go pick someone up
- {迎|むか}えに{来|く}る: to come pick someone up
- お{迎|むか}え: pick-up (polite, common at schools)
- {迎|むか}えを{頼|たの}む: to ask for a pick-up

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駅|えき}まで{迎|むか}えに{行|い}く: to go pick up at the station
- {空港|くうこう}で{迎|むか}える: to meet at the airport
- {新年|しんねん}を{迎|むか}える: to welcome the new year

Note: お{迎|むか}え is commonly used at kindergartens and schools when parents come to pick up children.
